summary: Polestar filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, attaching a press release announcing preliminary retail sales volumes for Q2 2026 and H1 2026. The press release reports record sales of 30,423 cars in H1 2026, with Q2 sales of 17,296 cars. CEO Michael Lohscheller comments on progress and model launches. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation transaction. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of material non-financial information, and does not involve any M&A, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven category.
